2607.12763.title: Constraint-Aware Aggregation for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Microgrid Energy Coordination
2607.12763.paper_summary: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FedRL) enables coordination of distributed energy resources without sharing raw local data, but standard aggregation methods such as FedAvg do not account for system-level constraints, often leading to unsafe global behavior. In this work, we study constraint-aware aggregation for federated reinforcement learning in distributed energy coordination. We propose aggregation rules that incorporate both local performance and estimated constraint violation into the server-side update. Among these, a simple penalty-based rule, $w_i \propto R_i - αV_i$, consistently provides the most reliable trade-off between reward and safety, without requiring dual optimization or modifications to local training. \textcolor{black}{We evaluate our approach on DairyGridEnv, a benchmark modeling multiple farms coordinating battery storage under stochastic demand and a shared grid capacity constraint, and further assess robustness using real load-driven demand profiles from Finland and the German FIELD dataset. Across multiple seeds, penalty-based aggregation substantially reduces violations while improving reward relative to FedAvg in both synthetic and real load-driven settings.} A combined reward-violation scheme exposes a tunable trade-off via $λ$, but is less stable. These results demonstrate that lightweight aggregation strategies can substantially improve empirical safety in federated reinforcement learning while preserving standard communication protocols.
2607.12763.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦強化學習（FedRL）能夠協調分散式能源資源，而無需共享原始本地數據，但標準聚合方法如FedAvg並未考慮系統級約束，常常導致不安全的全局行為。在本研究中，我們探討了在分散式能源協調中，針對聯邦強化學習的約束感知聚合。我們提出了聚合規則，將本地性能和估計的約束違規納入伺服器端更新。在這些規則中，一個簡單的基於懲罰的規則，$w_i \propto R_i - αV_i$，始終提供了獎勵與安全之間最可靠的權衡，而無需雙重優化或對本地訓練的修改。 \textcolor{black}{我們在DairyGridEnv上評估我們的方法，這是一個基準模型，模擬多個農場在隨機需求和共享電網容量約束下協調電池儲存，並進一步使用來自芬蘭和德國FIELD數據集的真實負載驅動需求配置來評估穩健性。在多個隨機種子下，基於懲罰的聚合顯著減少了違規，同時在合成和真實負載驅動環境中相對於FedAvg提高了獎勵。} 結合獎勵-違規方案通過$λ$暴露了一個可調的權衡，但穩定性較差。這些結果表明，輕量級聚合策略可以顯著提高聯邦強化學習中的實證安全性，同時保留標準通信協議。
2607.12763.author: Usman Haider et.al.
